items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...And a guy called Jesse on tuba. I don't know who Jesse is. ... [INTERVIEWEE] That's John Porter. Might be. That's where it is. We didn't have no other fella but John Porter.

ctx.x: Well that might be him. I tried to have a voice in minor. That might be him.
He went to St. Louis. He's from St. Louis it says here, the saxophone player. And a guy called Jesse on tuba. I don't know who Jesse is. Big dog dog fella it looks like.
That's John Porter. Might be. That's where it is. We didn't have no other fella but John Porter.
